protocol.statistics: 4000-draw paired seed percentile bootstrap, RNG 4099; exploratory, no multiplicity adjustment
protocol.ablation: H2 has identical capacity-aware meter candidates; fixed 0.1 Mbps headroom, no memory. A4 explores then selects headroom using prior observed reward.
limits: Fluid simulation, not packet capture or real OpenFlow deployment
Network benchmarks use local policies, not LLM calls
H1 improvements can come from new meter logic; H2 isolates the extra memory effect
O2 is a privileged immediate-reward reference, not a deployable or long-horizon bound
Final memory flush excluded from per-window local timings
protocol.implementation_repair: Post-run binary rounding repair at exact 20% meter floor: admit one extra kbps when required by the unchanged strict guard. Full suite rerun; pre-repair CSV/summary preserved in pre_numeric_repair. No outcome-driven hyperparameter tuning.
